prerequisites.requirement: All seven LP132 gates have governed, affirmative evidence.
A schema-valid county authorization record exists in the statewide registry.
Operational, deployment, runtime, geometry, and membership approvals are all present and governed.
County-specific runtime validation and operational controls are satisfied.
Change, rollback, observation, ownership, and production controls are satisfied.
The non-authorizing planner has evaluated the valid authorization record.

failClosedRule: Missing, null, invalid, inferred, or incomplete evidence never authorizes activation.
